timeline.text: Every article rewrite into three languages quietly added to a metered API bill.
Multiply that across every blog post and news rewrite, and the costs added up fast.
It's like paying per minute for a phone line you already have unlimited minutes on.
Now those jobs try my Claude subscription first, falling back to the paid API only if needed.
Five content-writing paths switched over, and the per-call bill for them dropped to zero.
